children: On November 24, 2026, Scilex Holding received notice from Nasdaq that it was not in compliance with Listing Rule 5250(c)(1) because it had not timely filed its Form 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The company has until January 25, 2027, to submit a plan to regain compliance; if Nasdaq accepts the plan, it may grant an exception until May 24, 2027, to file the report.
